agencies.name: Department of Passports
agencies.summary_en: Passport issues are handled by the Department of Passports, district offices, or Nepal missions abroad.
agencies.summary_ne: राहदानी सम्बन्धी समस्या राहदानी विभाग वा जिल्ला/नियोग सेवा मार्फत हेरिन्छ।

agencies.name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
agencies.summary_en: For abroad or consular issues, contact the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or the relevant Nepal mission.
agencies.summary_ne: विदेशमा आपतकालीन वा कन्सुलर समस्या भए परराष्ट्र मन्त्रालय/सम्बन्धित नेपाली नियोगसँग सम्पर्क गर्नुहोस्।

agencies.name: Department of Consular Services
agencies.serviceName: Document attestation and consular services in Nepal
agencies.summary_en: Document attestation, NRN, and related consular paperwork inside Nepal are handled by the Department of Consular Services.
agencies.summary_ne: कागजात प्रमाणीकरण, एनआरएन र स्वदेशमा कन्सुलर सेवा कन्सुलर सेवा विभागले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Inland Revenue Department
agencies.summary_en: PAN and tax matters are handled by the Inland Revenue Department or the nearest revenue office.
agencies.summary_ne: PAN वा कर सम्बन्धी विषय आन्तरिक राजस्व विभाग वा नजिकको आन्तरिक राजस्व कार्यालयले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Department of Customs
agencies.summary_en: Import/export clearance and customs duty questions are handled by the Department of Customs.
agencies.summary_ne: आयात/निर्यात जाँचपास र भन्सार महसुल भन्सार विभागले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Nepal Rastra Bank
agencies.serviceName: Central bank and banking regulation help
agencies.summary_en: Banking regulation, foreign exchange notices, and central-bank information are published by Nepal Rastra Bank.
agencies.summary_ne: बैंकिङ नियमन, विदेशी विनिमय सूचना र केन्द्रीय बैंक जानकारी नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकले प्रकाशन गर्छ।

agencies.name: Employees Provident Fund
agencies.summary_en: Employee provident fund contributions, claims, and account services are handled by the Employees Provident Fund.
agencies.summary_ne: कर्मचारी सञ्चय कोष योगदान, दाबी र खाता सेवा कर्मचारी सञ्चय कोषले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Citizen Investment Trust
agencies.summary_en: CIT savings and retirement schemes are administered by the Citizen Investment Trust.
agencies.summary_ne: नागरिक लगानी कोष बचत तथा अवकाश योजना नागरिक लगानी कोषले सञ्चालन गर्छ।

agencies.name: District Administration Office
agencies.summary_en: Lost citizenship certificate or copy requests are handled by your District Administration Office.
agencies.summary_ne: नागरिकता हराएको वा प्रतिलिपि चाहिएको विषय आफ्नो जिल्ला प्रशासन कार्यालयले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Department of National ID and Civil Registration
agencies.summary_en: National ID cards and civil registration (birth, death, marriage) are handled by the Department of National ID and Civil Registration and local registration offices.
agencies.summary_ne: राष्ट्रिय परिचयपत्र तथा जन्म/मृत्यु/विवाह दर्ता राष्ट्रिय परिचयपत्र तथा पञ्जीकरण विभाग र स्थानीय पञ्जिकाधिकारी कार्यालयले हेर्छन्।

agencies.name: Election Commission Nepal
agencies.summary_en: Voter registration and election information are handled by the Election Commission Nepal.
agencies.summary_ne: मतदाता नामावली र निर्वाचन जानकारी निर्वाचन आयोग नेपालले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Nepal Police
agencies.summary_en: First information reports, lost-document police reports, and emergencies are handled by Nepal Police.
agencies.summary_ne: जाहेरी, हराएको कागजातको रिपोर्ट र आपतकालीन सहयोग नेपाल प्रहरीले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Department of Immigration
agencies.summary_en: Entry, exit, visas, and stay permits are handled by the Department of Immigration.
agencies.summary_ne: भिसा, प्रवेश/बहिर्गमन र बसोबास अनुमति अध्यागमन विभागले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Ministry of Labour, Employment and Social Security
agencies.summary_en: Domestic labour disputes, employment services, and labour-office routing are handled by MoLESS and labour offices.
agencies.summary_ne: स्वदेशी श्रम विवाद, रोजगार सेवा र श्रम कार्यालय श्रम, रोजगार तथा सामाजिक सुरक्षा मन्त्रालयले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Department of Foreign Employment
agencies.parent: Ministry of Labour, Employment and Social Security
agencies.summary_en: Labour permits, recruitment complaints, and migrant-worker protection are handled by the Department of Foreign Employment.
agencies.summary_ne: वैदेशिक रोजगार अनुमति, उजुरी र श्रमिक संरक्षण वैदेशिक रोजगार विभागले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Social Security Fund
agencies.parent: Ministry of Labour, Employment and Social Security
agencies.summary_en: Contribution-based social security (medical, accident, old age) is administered by the Social Security Fund.
agencies.summary_ne: योगदानमा आधारित सामाजिक सुरक्षा कोषले स्वास्थ्य, दुर्घटना र वृद्धावस्था सुविधा हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Public Service Commission
agencies.summary_en: Civil service vacancies and exams are administered by the Public Service Commission (Lok Sewa Aayog).
agencies.summary_ne: निजामती सेवा विज्ञापन र परीक्षा लोक सेवा आयोगले सञ्चालन गर्छ।

agencies.name: Ministry of Education, Science and Technology
agencies.summary_en: SEE, scholarships, and school-administration questions are routed through the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology and related offices.
agencies.summary_ne: SEE, छात्रवृत्ति र विद्यालय प्रशासन शिक्षा, विज्ञान तथा प्रविधि मन्त्रालय र सम्बन्धित कार्यालयले हेर्छन्।

agencies.name: National Examination Board
agencies.parent: Ministry of Education, Science and Technology
agencies.summary_en: SEE and board examination notices, results, and registration are handled by the National Examination Board.
agencies.summary_ne: SEE तथा बोर्ड परीक्षा सूचना, नतिजा र दर्ता राष्ट्रिय परीक्षा बोर्डले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training
agencies.summary_en: Technical and vocational training programmes and affiliation notices are handled by CTEVT.
agencies.summary_ne: प्राविधिक तथा व्यावसायिक तालिम र सम्बन्धन सूचना CTEVT ले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Ministry of Health and Population
agencies.summary_en: Public hospital and national health-programme routing is handled by the Ministry of Health and Population. This is not personal medical advice.
agencies.summary_ne: सरकारी अस्पताल र राष्ट्रिय स्वास्थ्य कार्यक्रम स्वास्थ्य तथा जनसंख्या मन्त्रालयले रूट गर्छ। यो व्यक्तिगत चिकित्सा सल्लाह होइन।

agencies.name: Health Insurance Board
agencies.summary_en: Enrolment and claims for the national health insurance programme are handled by the Health Insurance Board.
agencies.summary_ne: राष्ट्रिय स्वास्थ्य बीमा भर्ना र दाबी स्वास्थ्य बीमा बोर्डले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Department of Transport Management
agencies.summary_en: Driving license renewal and related issues are handled by a transport management office.
agencies.summary_ne: सवारी चालक अनुमतिपत्र नवीकरण वा समस्या यातायात व्यवस्था कार्यालयले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Department of Transport Management
agencies.summary_en: Vehicle registration, bluebook, and number-plate matters are handled by transport management offices under DOTM.
agencies.summary_ne: सवारी दर्ता, ब्लुबुक र नम्बर प्लेट यातायात व्यवस्था कार्यालयले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Nepal Telecom
agencies.summary_en: NTC mobile, landline, and FTTH service questions are handled by Nepal Telecom offices and official NTC channels.
agencies.summary_ne: NTC मोबाइल, ल्यान्डलाइन र FTTH सेवा नेपाल टेलिकम कार्यालय तथा आधिकारिक च्यानलले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Nepal Electricity Authority
agencies.summary_en: Electricity connections, billing, and outage notices are handled by the Nepal Electricity Authority.
agencies.summary_ne: बिजुली जडान, बिल र लोडसेडिङ/आउटेज सूचना नेपाल विद्युत प्राधिकरणले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Nepal Telecommunications Authority
agencies.summary_en: Telecom service complaints and numbering issues can be taken to the Nepal Telecommunications Authority.
agencies.summary_ne: दूरसञ्चार उजुरी र नम्बर सम्बन्धी विषय नेपाल दूरसञ्चार प्राधिकरणले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Department of Postal Services
agencies.summary_en: Mail, parcel, and postal savings questions are handled by the Department of Postal Services / GPO.
agencies.summary_ne: पत्र, पार्सल र हुलाक बचत हुलाक सेवा विभाग / GPO ले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Department of Land Management and Archive
agencies.parent: Ministry of Land Management, Cooperatives and Poverty Alleviation
agencies.summary_en: Land ownership records (lalpurja) and malpot services are handled by land revenue offices under the Department of Land Management and Archive.
agencies.summary_ne: जग्गाधनी प्रमाणपुर्जा र मालपोत सेवा जग्गा व्यवस्था तथा अभिलेख विभाग अन्तर्गतका कार्यालयले हेर्छन्।

agencies.name: Ministry of Federal Affairs and General Administration
agencies.summary_en: Ward-level recommendations, local registration, and municipal services are handled by local governments under MoFAGA.
agencies.summary_ne: वडा सिफारिस, स्थानीय दर्ता र नगरपालिका सेवा सङ्घीय मामिला तथा सामान्य प्रशासन मन्त्रालय अन्तर्गत स्थानीय तहले हेर्छन्।

agencies.name: Office of the Company Registrar
agencies.parent: Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Supplies
agencies.summary_en: Company incorporation and registry updates are handled by the Office of the Company Registrar.
agencies.summary_ne: कम्पनी दर्ता र अद्यावधिक कम्पनी रजिस्ट्रारको कार्यालयले हेर्छ।

agencies.name: Department of Tourism
agencies.parent: Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation
agencies.summary_en: Trekking and tourism-permit questions are routed through the Department of Tourism and related immigration or conservation offices.
agencies.summary_ne: ट्रेकिङ र पर्यटन अनुमति पर्यटन विभाग तथा सम्बन्धित अध्यागमन/संरक्षण कार्यालयले हेर्छन्।
